contributions.detail: Schedule A (p2) carries the single token '-0-' in the row area and no transactions. Printed 'Subtotal for this page $-0-' and 'Total Contributions Received $ -0-'; Box B (This Period) = '-0-' and Box C (Year-to-Date) = '-0-'. Per the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling '-0-' DENOTES zero, so all four figures are 0 and the two scopes coincide at zero; the verbatim glyph is retained in every anchor string. This CFD form has no separate <=$50 aggregate line, so the le50 keys are null.

expenditures.detail: Schedule B (p3) carries the single token '-0-' and no transactions. Printed 'Subtotal for this page $ -0-' and 'Total Expenditures Made $ -0-'; Box D (This Period) = '-0-' = 0, which the empty schedule matches exactly. The rows do NOT match Box E (Expenditures Made Year-to-Date), which the filer wrote as '$450' - so this report itemizes a period, not the cycle, and the $450 of cycle-to-date spending is disclosed only as a summary figure here. Scope is therefore period. The $450 is NOT itemizable from this document and must not be inferred into rows.

gates.page_subtotal: p2: 0 rows sum 0.00 = printed Subtotal '$-0-' = printed Total '$ -0-' (gates). p3: 0 rows sum 0.00 = printed Subtotal '$ -0-' = printed Total '$ -0-' (gates). Both sides gate. Separately noted, not a gate failure: Box E ($450) exceeds this report's Schedule B total, which is a scope difference (year-to-date vs this period), not a reconciliation miss.
gates.row_count: Born-digital CFD with an unruled schedule area, so rowbands.py has no grid to score. Counted by ink: p2 one non-transaction token '-0-'; p3 one non-transaction token '-0-'. Zero transaction rows on either side, zero rows emitted.
gates.geometry_proof: No rows emitted, so no row geometry to prove. Both schedule row areas were rendered full-page at 200 dpi and hold only the single '-0-' token beneath the header rule.
gates.balance_chain: Box A '-0-' + Box B '-0-' = Box F 0 (closes); Box F 0 - Box D '-0-' = Balance at Close 0 (closes). Chain closes exactly. NOTE the filer switched notation mid-page - boxes A/B/C/D use the '-0-' glyph while F and the closing balance use a plain '0'; both are transcribed as printed. The chain does NOT account for Box E's $450: with $450 of year-to-date expenditures and '-0-' year-to-date contributions, the cycle figures cannot produce a zero closing balance. That is the FILER's arithmetic and is left untouched. Cross-filing chain NOT run: only the June-16 Bennett filing is in this chunk (a PreCon 2026 Bennett report exists in the county corpus but is outside it).

escalation_note: Born-digital vector PDF; every figure renders crisply at 200 dpi and matches the embedded text layer. No bistable glyphs, so no crop escalation was warranted.
